input.summary: Add successor/M&A carve-out for Client, reasonableness standard, and competitor bar on TrueLink assignments
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out so that we may assign without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made TrueLink's assignments subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and not to our competitors. Our playbook requires freedom to reorganize or be acquired without vendor consent; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; provided, that no such approval shall be required for (a) an assignment by either party to a financially responsible affiliate or (b) an assignment by Client to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. In no event shall TrueLink assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Client. No change in the ownership or control of Client shall constitute an assignment hereunder or give rise to any right of TrueLink to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
